import pandas as pd

# Load the time_series_data.csv dataset
df_time_series = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')

# Calculate the rolling mean of the 'Depot_inter' values
rolling_mean = df_time_series['Depot_inter'].rolling(window=100).mean()

# Identify the index of the maximum rolling mean
max_index = rolling_mean.argmax()

# Determine the corresponding 'CE' value
peak_ce = df_time_series['CE'].iloc[max_index]

# Determine the century
peak_century = peak_ce // 100

peak_century
